gold_schedule_amendment.implementation_artifact_requirement: Publish amended roll-map bytes and SHA256 before reading settlement prices. Validate against frozen v1 calendar and dated identities.
gold_schedule_amendment.interval_construction: Use previous mapped active contract at both endpoints. On roll date also require and seed new active contract settlement. Never subtract different contracts.
gold_schedule_amendment.method: Map each v1 selected October gold maturity to December of the same explicit full year; leave other gold maturities and all other markets unchanged.
gold_schedule_amendment.raw_symbol_transform: GCVy -> GCZy with full maturity year preserved
recompute: gold active LTD and exit metadata using December maturity rules, never copied October deadlines
gold_schedule_amendment.scope: Hypothetical child exposures on parent settlements; matching child execution is not established

information_policy.amendment_reason: All72 v1 windows were incomplete. Historical CME active gold sequence excludes October; official settlement messages are an explicit separate reference source. These changes were chosen from coverage/contract evidence without a v1 return result.
information_policy.capital_verdict_gate: All72 verified sizing outcomes required for an all-cash capital rejection. Missing/ambiguous data and search limits are unresolved, never capital failure.
information_policy.not_a_holdout: 2018-2023 remains seen development/feasibility; no claim of untouched validation.
information_policy.reference_limit: Product settlements occur at different times. This replaces the bounded-asynchronous minute reference with a causal end-of-day settlement panel; it does not establish simultaneous or executable marks.

pre_price_clarification: At an otherwise tied ordering key, prefer the documented clearing-tick precision (stat_flags bit4 clear) when present; otherwise use trading-tick precision. This semantic rule is fixed before any settlement prices are read. No other rule changes.
registration_type: Local pre-settlement-price-read data amendment; not an external timestamp or independent holdout
scope: Sizing participation only. No P&L, performance selection, live orders or funded approval.

selection.deletions: Any stat_type3/rtype24 DELETE(action2) for the instrument/session available by cutoff invalidates the whole day reference, regardless actual/final/intraday flags and even if another ADD exists. Conservative policy because documented delete matching is insufficient; do not invent a resurrection/matching rule.
selection.eligibility: stat_type3/rtype24 ADD(action1), stat_flags&2 !=0 and stat_flags&8 ==0; positive finite normalized price required. stat_flags integer must be0..15. Invalid candidate fields leave DATA_INCOMPLETE.
selection.finality: Final bit1 is recorded but not required or preferred over chronology. Latest eligible actual nonintraday message available by cutoff is selected; later final/revised prices are excluded.
selection.missing: No candidate, invalid identity/date/timestamp, missing roll endpoint or unresolved conflict -> DATA_INCOMPLETE; no fills, gap compression or fallback source/time.
ordering: require one publisher_id and channel_id among remaining tie; otherwise DATA_INCOMPLETE

At the final tied ordering key, retain only clearing-tick records (stat_flags&4 ==0) if any exist; otherwise retain trading-tick records. Deduplicate identical relevant records. Differing prices or other stat_flags within the chosen precision -> DATA_INCOMPLETE.
selection.tick_convention: Fixed tie-only precision preference: clearing tick (bit4 clear) if available at the final tied ordering key; otherwise trading tick. Preserve selected flag. Never choose a price based on observed returns or use precision to override chronology.
selection.unsupported_action: Any pre-cutoff settlement action outside1/2 for that key -> DATA_INCOMPLETE

session_and_cutoff.availability_order_timestamp: genuine ts_recv when available under the modern rule; otherwise legacy ts_event
session_and_cutoff.cutoff: 16:30:00 America/Chicago on that literal session date; timezone-aware conversion to UTC including DST.
session_and_cutoff.event_gate: ts_event must be finite/valid and <= session cutoff. Later revisions never affect that day reference.
session_and_cutoff.legacy_capture_policy: For earlier messages, capture timestamps are unavailable from the source. Use ts_event only; ignore unavailable or synthetic ts_recv, and label the reference LEGACY_EVENT_TIME_PROXY. This is not verified historic receipt-time availability.
session_and_cutoff.modern_capture_gate: For messages on/after genuine capture start, ts_recv must be finite/valid, >= ts_event and <= cutoff. Missing/null/UINT64_MAX capture timestamp makes that instrument/session DATA_INCOMPLETE.
session_and_cutoff.session_day: Literal UTC calendar date encoded in ts_ref (CME TradingReferenceDate). Do not timezone-convert ts_ref into Chicago. ts_ref must be finite, valid and date-precision midnight UTC.

sources.facts: Official venue statistics; settlement stat_type3/rtype24; price1e-9; event/receive/reference timestamps; update_action1 added/2 deleted.
ts_ref is date-precision TradingReferenceDate; multiple preliminary/final messages; stat_flags bits1/2/4/8; settlement unavailable on MDP for instruments without open interest or volume.
